determinism_note: Earlier revisions of this proof passed on macOS and failed in this container. Root cause: stop_worker killed only the Wrangler parent, leaving the child workerd alive, so the restart was a no-op and the Durable Object was never re-initialized. The proof now terminates the full process tree, waits for /api/health to stop answering, and asserts the posted run_id is present in the inspected queue database before checking the retired schema.
